title: So with great relief I switched back to my old fashioned hand ...
text: So with great relief I switched back to my old fashioned hand .... Was very excited to try after seeing my sisters slicer (Walmart brand).  However after a few minutes of trying the top kept slipping off the vegetable and it wasn't producing much product.  So with great relief I switched back to my old fashioned hand held shredder.  I am going to try the other side sometime this week and see if I have more luck with the larger cutter - but I think I may have wasted my money.  Also the recipe ebook has alot of "spaghetti" recipes - I was hoping for more veggie casserole or side dish ideas.
